hero.headline: A Taste of Authentic Italian Craftsmanship
hero.subheadline: Handcrafted pasta, wood-fired Neapolitan pizzas, imported truffles, and sommelier-curated vintage wines.

about.title: Passionate Culinary Tradition
about.body: Founded by Chef Marco Rossi, Bella Vista honors recipes passed down through three generations of Tuscan cooks, using organic farm-to-table ingredients.

services.title: Handcrafted Fresh Pasta
services.description: Tagliatelle al Tartufo, Pappardelle al Cinghiale, and homemade Ricotta Ravioli.

services.title: Wood-Fired Neapolitan Pizza
services.description: Baked in a 900°F volcanic stone oven with San Marzano tomatoes and Buffalo Mozzarella.

services.title: Private Dining & Events
services.description: Exclusive wine room for private celebrations, corporate dinners, and tasting menus.

testimonials.name: Gourmet Magazine
testimonials.quote: Bella Vista serves the single best Osso Buco outside of Milan. Unforgettable dining experience!

faq.q: Do you accommodate gluten-free and vegan diets?
faq.a: Yes, we offer gluten-free pasta and dairy-free mozzarella choices upon request.
